text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Bouquet-chan♪
You're up early this morning too, aren't you?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Good morningâCurren-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I saw Bouquet-chan while running,
so I came over.
Are you doing your Beautification Committee duties right now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah... This is just something I took upon myself to do every morning, so...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Never changes, does she?
The Miho dorm is probably always squeaky clean
thanks to Bouquet-chan."

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, Bouquet-chan.
I'm the one who spilled the water, and yet you're helping me wipe it up...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—more importantly, I'm glad
that your clothes didn't get wet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If you substitute it in here—the answer should come out.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right! I finally get it...!
Thank you, Bouquet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Bouquet-chan. There's a favor
Curren wants to ask of you."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Just for tomorrow, okay?
—Would you be my princess?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: A-A princess... you say?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. For all of tomorrow, leave everything
around you to your retainer Curren.
Just sit back, and relaaax♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look. You played pretend when you were little, right?
...It's the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, understood.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Princessâª

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
...Oh my, what is that broom for...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren took care of sweeping outside the dorms,
so don't worry your pretty little head about it, princess.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Well... thank you.
...On behalf of the Miho Dormitory residents—I thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, Princess.
I brought you some water♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. Thanks to Curren-chan,
—today has been a breeze.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“—How was that?
How did you like Curren's special massage?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, a huge weight has been lifted off my shoulders.
Phew―― Somehow,
I feel so at ease――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...If you'd like, shall we have some tea?
I have a little something prepared...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
! If I recall... these are the cookies
we always ate whenever I went over
to Bouquet-chan's house?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The other day... I happened to see her in town.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Since you're going to treat me like a princess today,
...I prepared this as a token of my appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. And after I said you were the "princess" today!
Bouquet-chan, you ended up preparing everything
for Curren after all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Really, you haven't changed at all since the old days.
Back when we used to play pretend—"

text_block_list.name: Young Curren
text_block_list.text: Geez! Bouquet-chan, you're playing the "Princess"! You shouldn't be cooking Curren's food too!

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. But...
I just really, really wanted to make it for you...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Does that mean
I'm going to get scolded again...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Geeez. You're always so unfair
only when it comes to Curren, Bouquet-chan..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...And that's pretty much how it went. What do you think
I should do to keep Bouquet-chan leaning on me forever,
Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: I think Bouquet should just stay the way she is
I was kind of hoping... you could tell me.
I was kind of hoping... you could tell me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...And that's pretty much how it went. What do you think
I should do to keep Bouquet-chan leaning on me forever,
Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: I think Bouquet should just stay the way she is
I was kind of hoping... you could tell me.
I was kind of hoping... you could tell me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, in the end,
I guess Curren thinks so too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...I want to—continue being Curren-chan's friend.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...... Being one-sided like that
might mean there's a lack of harmony.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "...Perhaps next time—you'll allow me to practice being pampered? Fufufu."
